notes.title: Solace Inc. v1.8 - Dissonance Update
notes.notes:
Hey gamers! Haven't touched this game in a while, but I'm back with some more content for Solace Inc. 1!

I was originally going to put out an update for April Fool's called the Cutting Board Update, which made some... 'character design changes'

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/cb38e8de415486da802f82f44c7a3f9d296e7418.png

...but Emily held me at gunpoint and made me change it back

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/f9e209f929b5beb88d9461da697efb91d67b988a.png

so, I had to pivot and added some other stuff that I wanted to add to the game a while back but was too busy working on Solace Inc. 2 to add, so I'm adding it now!

Boss Rush

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/cb709bd8e05f1adf83502a859551ecc75cf19c5e.png

It's time to prove your worth in the Arena of Champions and fight against an onslaught of foes from the past!

As I've worked on this game I never really had an end goal in sight and didn't plan on there being a 'final' mission, so I've decided to add this in to be a semblance of that

Dissonances

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/e33b21ebf8ec6924821029c97782f49e8af0f448.png

Anyone who's a lore enthusiast may have noticed that there's some characters in this game who canonically shouldn't be fighting alongside each other, so I've decided to fix that!

Dissonances are essentially Anti-Synergies, when certain characters are pair together they still start fighting each other instead of working together

Other stuff

I've also added in the usual stuff that I usually add (new recruits, new dialogue, new synergies, yadda yadda yadda) as well as some balance changes and gameplay adjustments

A major thing I should note is that enemies will no longer parry attacks, as I was working on the Boss Rush mission having to deal with minibosses constantly parrying attacks was a little bit annoying so I decided to remove that entirely, and the achievement along with it

Recruits and minibosses will also sidestrafe when attacking things now, so hopefully that will make combat a little more interesting instead of everyone just standing still while you occasionally jump over bullets and whatnot

That's basically it, this update is sort of a mixture of a late April Fool's update and a Sequel Promo update, hope you enjoy! (I'm also going to be updating the Android version soon, haven't touched that in a while lol)

- recruits involved in a Dissonance will battle each other and can perish

notes.title: OST Release, Small Update, & Solace Inc 2 News
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I'm back with a small update and a few announcements!

Solace Inc. OST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/455f31d00a61a701ab56c0eb04c576be1e5414b5.png

The Solace Inc OST Album is out now! It's available on:

Steam
Bandcamp
and YouTube!

I meant to release this after the game came out and completely forgot about it (adhd moment), so it's now available to download and listen for yourself!

It doesn't include any of the boss stage themes, those were created by Frogrammer so they're not mine to profit off of (although I do believe he's put it on Spotify)

v1.7.2 Update

I've also released a small update for the game, I've added some new recruits (as always) as well as an update to the Art Gallery mission which includes some new artwork!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/56d3e3403a79b306dd534140f051e4b741cc7646.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/5d2ed31c5c8982443e4a45f33edeaed8d872e4e3.png

Most of it is from Art Fight 2024, I wanted to include them because a bunch of talented artists made art of characters from the game and wanted everyone to see it!
(I've also added some art viewing controls like zooming + panning to make it easier to see certain parts of the pieces)

If you have any questions + issues with the update feel free to DM me on Discord (@aplove)

Solace Inc. 2

Over the past few months or so I've been working on a sequel to Solace Inc, Solace Inc 2!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/a27480e3d5c56e93d220b89e53e2ede7c1430bff.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/efe696ad67cbe5614a38609503343433cc6731f2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/5159e4cc6f1f6f1177387eda5637d565f7452404.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/8b2628045ed927838e0e80bdd62b92fbe89e7eeb.png

(It's not really a direct sequel per se, it's just a new game that uses the same settings & characters so I'm calling it one)

I've switched over the using Godot instead of GameMaker Studio 2 and have been teaching myself 3D modelling via Blender and have been enjoying it, I've been wanting to make a proper 3D game for a while now

I'm also planning on it being an online multiplayer game, originally was going to have it be PvP but after doing some research it seems like a lot of indie PvP games tend to die out after a week due to low player counts so I'm probably going to have it be a co-op PvE game instead

It's very barebones and I've only been working on it for a few months so I can't say what the future plans for it are, but I may(?) have a small demo out sometime soon

That's all I wanted to share, thank you all for continuing to support the game! Have fun and enjoy!

notes.title: Solace Inc. v1.7 - Chrono Corp Update
notes.notes:
Hey gamers! The Chrono Corp update is finally here!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/f7b699999eac25815bdba1f5020a3ac49d144fb3.png
Solace Inc. v1.7 features a brand-new mode where you can play as Solace Inc.'s rival, Chrono Corp! This isn't just new playable characters, this new mode fundamentally changes how the game overall is played! (It's practically an entirely different game!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/99fcf667f8a97b8bb5a117957144d3d83ebc80fd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/19d5058f82d17a27c3290672c5c6b472ae73b8bc.png
While playing as Chrono Corp:

 Troops are recruited through cost at any time instead of levelling up
 Level up bar is replaced with an energy bar that builds up when collecting gems
 Instead of upgrading actives and passives, Chrono Corp can buy and use Potions, which provide a quick temporary effect, and Artifacts which provide permanent global effects like passives do
 There is no maximum amount of troops and you can recruit multiple of the same troop, however troops will perish instead of being stunned
 Troops, Potions, and Artifacts all have rarity values (Common, Rare, Epic, & Legendary)
 Research upgrades troops individually instead of globally
 ...and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/463f7a20aff9a5c8b37b78ddf6ee71842033758c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/df00fc29c2b62e08a1b0497923c45950a9d5cded.png
This update also features some new content, such as Week 7 (4 new missions!)

One of the missions is an art gallery featuring artwork by yours truly, and some fanart people have sent me!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/f2b3626d729bf9e300bce2ca8b414c6bca217713.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/8acedda4f493cf22f680caf83fbae337db7b21f3.png

alright gang it's time to lose our life savings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/9c0f44724ef3ca2d909bcb54b056d75a91fd38c9.png

There's also new recruits, new alternates, blah blah blah you get the idea, new stuff!! Go check it out now!!

I'm pretty excited for this one, been working on this update for a while and am glad at how it's turned out so far. Thank you to the folks who played the prerelease builds, I appreciate the feedback! If you encounter any issues, feel free to DM me on Discord (@aplove) and I'll try to have stuff worked out asap.

Thank you for playing! Cheers!

notes.title: Solace Inc. v1.6 - Fusion Update
notes.notes:
Hey gang, new Solace Inc. update!! Yippee!!

The two main things this update adds are Endless Mode and Fusion Recruits!

Fusion Recruits

A few weeks ago I made a drawing of some of the characters in Solace Inc. fused together just to see what they would look like, and I decided to add them into the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/931db0e05f4a04d5847f02ab7863a46285b027a3.png

Fusion Recruits are characters that are created when playing as Jordan's little sister, Sarah! When recruits are near her, she will fuse them together which combines both their actives and passives into one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/5521266a3813f0791b477c02a674138b9701f62c.png

(some of them are pretty powerful)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/4b2828898c5194488d745a5688cd176c161b17ce.png

Fusions don't appear in the upgrade menu after you've unlocked them, so the only way to make them appear (aside from setting one as your leader) is to have Sarah on your team

Endless Mode

Endless Mode is a new mission that appears before Mission 1 that works a little differently than the rest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/c2768d8674197a1451191f6a40074c0a4bac1474.png

It drops you into a randomized environment, and your objective is to stay alive for as long as possible! Research is disabled in this mission, and recruits can perish so make sure you keep them alive! There's also a leaderboard for this mission, so try to get the highest score possible! (I bet you can't beat mine)

There's also some other new stuff like new breakroom dialogue, visual changes, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/7d44d10fc19a197a9ae6b42e499f461a6335bca1.png

Also, to test out this update I added in a developer console to speed things up, if you want to play around with it you can open it up with alt

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/7ca630a6d849b8ac059f7ad814f3e7d435f997ce.png

That's pretty much it, I'm probably going to do at least one small patch to include some new cameo recruits, if you encounter any issues with the game feel free to contact me on discord (@aplove) and I'll try to have it fixed asap

The game is also on sale for the Steam Spring Sale, so if you enjoy the game grab a copy for your friend! (it's required for 100% achievements)

Also, quick update on the mobile version: I've gotten back to working on it and am hoping to have it out on Google Play for Android soon! (hopefully by the end of the month)

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Solace Inc. v1.5 - Valentine's Day Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys! We've got another Solace Inc. update to celebrate Valentine's Day! 💖

This update features Week 6, which has new missions that are holiday-themed! It also features new recruits, new enemies, new bosses, and a bunch of other small changes and additions! (and bug fixes of course)

New Missions
Woah! Harpies? Cool!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/4222bd597560c5cfa471d231437c8decc6369a2f.png

Killer Snowmen? With guns??

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/572cb66eab57e68d6ebe2c888ad8980dca923bdc.png

New Enemies
I've added in some new enemies to a few of the previous stages to spice them up a bit, such as a new enemy in the mining mission, enemies in both of the boss missions, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/d2c85c1822a4bb5c0478b52af35fa07f618b4656.png

New Lootcrates
There are two new lootcrates under the research tab, the Employee Crate and the Ultimate Crate! 

The former works like the Cameo Crate except it unlocks a random employee (one of my characters) so you don't have to go into the missions to unlock characters if you don't want, and the latter unlocks every single recruit in the game that you haven't unlocked yet at once! (although it's very expensive)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/7f4d29b1b9aac3f6113ce8c3fad1d906911ac041.png

Other Minor Additions

There's also some small changes like more stats on the pause screen/mission end screen, an auto upgrade option (so if you're playing as grim reaper the game doesn't stop every 2 seconds, or if you just wanna get wacky), and other stuff like the game now adjusting the resolution when you fullscreen it so the text doesn't look as weird as it did, I meant to fix that a while back but never got around to it lol

Valentine's Day Cards

Some of the lovely ladies over at Solace made some Valentine's Day cards for you guys as well! 🥺💕

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/ce632687b97b185898e91d311061002c8801651e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/3bae5f821b2034f9c87441e8e5275cb0c4f95966.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/00311cb280bf3545305587444bdf3b9c20185955.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/0dc4a8ea7e80706ac1baec05a9a116eb7450ba88.png

I hope you guys enjoy this update! I really appreciate the support you guys have given the game so far (especially with the dialogue thing I talked about last week, thank you for the comments 💖), I didn't really expect that many people to play or even like this game that much, and I wouldn't still be working on it if it weren't for the lovely people who play it so thank you guys 🥺💕

If you encounter any bugs/issues or have feedback you can DM me directly on Discord (@aplove) and I'll try to have it fixed asap 🤘

Thank you for playing!!

notes.title: v1.4.0.11 Patch (aka the Vivziepop Update)
notes.notes:
- rewrote a large portion of the dialogue to make it overall less raunchy and more tame
  + there are still mature sections of dialogue, but it should be much less frequent than previously
- added recruits
- added alternates
- added toggles for particles and damage numbers in options
- minor adjustments

So... I recently got some feedback about the game's dialogue and... wow. Yeah, apparently it's... pretty bad.

Someone dm'ed me with some feedback and they said that the dialogue was "vivziepop tier". I asked a group of individuals what they thought about that and they pretty much all agreed. There was also a negative review yesterday that said the same thing. Someone even said that it's Amy Schumer levels, which is... honestly much worse.

I had no idea that it was that bad. I honestly thought that the dialogue was fine, but hearing this genuinely was disheartening. Like, no joke, it actually hurt.

So, I decided to rewrite a lot of the dialogue in the game to make it a lot more tame. There's still some mature sections in some of the dialogue, but overall that kind of stuff should be a lot less frequent. Some sections I just completely cut out or replaced. I don't know if this will make the dialogue better or not, but hopefully I trimmed away enough for it to not as bad as it was. I think the biggest culprits were some of the earlier stuff that I wrote several months ago, which is what most people were encountering and is what shied them away from the rest of the dialogue or from the game entirely.

I deeply apologize to anyone who wasn't able to experience the game to it's fullest extent because of the dialogue. I know that it's a pretty minor part of the game overall and won't affect most people, but it's important to me that every aspect of the game is, at a bare minimum, tolerable. If I had known this a lot sooner I would've changed it then. It's clear to me that not many people enjoy my writing style, and from now on I'm going to keep it more tame or reduce it overall so people are not uncomfortable with what I make.

I cannot make a perfect game. But I can make them better, and I can't do that without feedback from others. If you encounter anything, ANYTHING, that you do not like about this game, please feel free to dm me on Discord (@aplove) and I will do what I can to improve my craft. Thank you.

notes.notes:
Thank you for checking out Solace Inc. on Steam! The game is available RIGHT NOW for you to play!

v1.4 Update

This release also doubles as the v1.4 Update for anyone who played it in the AploVVare Collection, the major changes are basically the same as last time: new characters, new missions, new achievements, yadda yadda yadda. There's now 21 Missions in the game, and 130+ characters! Yowzers!!

There's also some new stuff like the character creator, which lets you create your own characters! You can also upload them to the Steam Workshop and download creations by other players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833993/f4cf3bec0374b66a50b1e645772ccf7ebe13cad1.png

There's also some other stuff like co-op (which you can enable by plugging in multiple controllers), new tabs in the Directory that show Synergies and enemies you've encountered, and some other quality-of-life changes.

Pretty big update, and I'm finally glad it's now available! Thank you to everyone who has supported the development of the game so far! 

If you have any feedback about the game or encounter any bugs/errors, feel free to let me know by messaging me on Discord (@aplove) and I'll try to have it fixed asap.

Also for anyone interested, I was planning on releasing the free 18+ DLC as well but I goofed up and forgot to add something so it's still under review by Valve, and they like to take their sweet time reviewing stuff so that will be available soon (maybe later today if we're lucky)

Thank you for playing!
